name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Russian operations launched a heavy ballistic barrage against Kyiv transport/medical assets and Kharkiv/Dnipro energy grids, while Ukrainian drone strikes hit the 75th Arsenal weapons plant in Serpukhov and assets in Lipetsk; German military upgraded Russian sabotage threat to 'significant'.

name: Armory Castle Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage group Armory Castle weaponizes BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day CVE-2026-102764 for initial network access.

name: ConnectWise Cloud Backup M365 Supply Chain Breach
summary: Formally attributed to Chinese state-sponsored actor Storm-0940, who weaponized the ARTEX agentic AI framework to target 2,250+ Microsoft 365 tenants via the ConnectWise multi-tenant app, automating password spraying, Graph reconnaissance, and credential backdoors.

name: Commercial BMS and Cold-Chain Disruption Campaign
summary: Cyber-physical sabotage targeting internet-exposed Danfoss, Emerson Copeland, and Dixell BMS controllers across European retail networks.

name: PEERSTITCH Fortinet Edge Exploitation Wave
summary: Threat actors (cluster CL-STA-0954) exploited FortiManager CVE-2024-47575 to exfiltrate configs and credentials from 500+ firewalls, deploying stealth in-memory ARM64 malware PEERSTITCH via FortiOS path traversal CVE-2025-61624.

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign
summary: Mercenary surveillance ecosystem targeting Serbian civil society ahead of elections; Citizen Lab confirmed University of Belgrade Rector Vladan Đokić was compromised with Pegasus via zero-click exploit, while prosecutor Rade Bajić received Apple Threat Notifications.

name: GhostAction CI/CD Credential Exfiltration Wave
summary: Supply chain compromise spanning 94+ GitHub repositories, using malicious workflows and weaponized developer font files to deliver infostealers and siphon cloud/CI credentials.

name: APT28 European Defense Espionage Campaign
summary: Russian GRU (APT28/Swallowtail) executing targeted intrusions against NATO naval shipbuilders, military aircraft engine manufacturers, and law enforcement agencies using Hookedge and custom ld.exe loaders.

name: Operation FlashHole Financial PKI Abuse
summary: Lazarus Group campaign weaponizing mandatory South Korean PKI financial security software INISAFE CrossWeb EX to compromise software, construction, and communications manufacturers.

name: SafePay Double-Extortion Campaign
summary: Ransomware operation targeting critical infrastructure across North America, Europe, and Australia by weaponizing edge VPN/firewall CVEs and legitimate administrative tooling.

name: eMudhra Compromised Intermediate CA Wave
summary: Compromise of eight intermediate CA private keys due to an entropy generation failure reducing P-384 keys to 3-8 bits, triggering revocations across major browsers and emergency updates to Go language runtimes (CVE-2026-111943).

name: Plex2Shell Opportunistic Weaponization Wave
summary: Automated exploitation of a chained four-vulnerability sequence in Plex Media Server added to the CISA KEV catalog, deploying crypto-miners and reverse proxies.

name: ShinyHunters Collusive Extortion Network
summary: Extortion campaign responsible for breaches of corporate and government targets, operating in collusive coordination with compromised cyber incident response negotiators.

name: PHP2Shell Global Remote Code Execution Wave
summary: Global mass-scanning and weaponization of critical unauthenticated RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) in core PHP handling of multipart/form-data with upload progress, impacting millions of internet-facing servers.

name: ROMULUS ClickFix Malware Delivery Cluster
summary: Malware delivery service deploying ClickFix lures via compromised landing pages and custom GPTs to execute PowerShell staging commands and deliver Legion Loader disguised with repetitive archive padding.
